name: Harrison 32C (UAD-2)
notes: Probed 2026-11-23: a VST-wrapped UAD-2 plugin, so every knob reports only its 0-1 position; values go through a table measured with tools/build-table.mjs.

CutEnable switches both filters (like an SSL Filters In). The low-pass has no OUT position: off from another strip parks it fully open (17.2 kHz), and fully open reads as off (openIsOff). LowPeak: Shelf or Peak; the other bands are bells.
Table built 2026-11-23; switch labels confirmed. Gain runs -10 to +10 (dB).
